prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1387; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

Our client was injured in a head-on collision that occurred at low speed, and is currently receiving medical treatment for injuries sustained in the incident. We request that you provide a complete statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes the policy and claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and appraisal records, adjuster notes, and any electronic communications. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
